property_summary: For any admissible depositToken (any positive token and staked-GLP amounts), a subsequent keeper executeBatchDeposit must transfer out exactly the tracked GLP and reset dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance to zero; the mutant deletes the reset, leaving a nonzero tracked balance after the call.
